g.text: Shaded column: designed change (orange blocks a PAM, purple is the edit). Dashed red line: cut.
Red base: differs from the control. Grey block: bases the clone lacks. The clone is laid onto the control at the offset used in the analysis.
Protein row: the control in the reading frame of the design. Box under a clone: its residue at each designed codon (as designed: purple or orange; as the control: grey; other: red).

svg.text: Homozygous for the intended editHomozygous for the intended edit
Heterozygous: intended edit on one allele, wild type on the otherHeterozygous: intended edit on one allele, wild type on…
Intended edit on one allele, partial conversion (blocking changes without the full edit) on the otherIntended edit on one allele, partial conversion (blocki…

Table: share of the donor base at each designed change, from the peak heights (0 = control base, 100 = donor base; n/a where an indel shifts the read). Call: A accept, H hold, S sequence again, R reject.
HDR score (ICE's KI score): the share of alleles that carry the intended edit, with its 95% interval; clones are ranked by the lower bound of the interval.
One read per clone (the first): the figure does not show allele phase, a large deletion on one allele or off-target edits.
